name: Boulder Badge
description: Proof of victory over Brock's Rock-type Gym. Boosts Attack and enables Flash in the field.

name: Cascade Badge
description: Won from Misty, the Tomboyish Mermaid. Makes traded Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey and enables Cut.

name: Thunder Badge
description: Earned by out-sparking the Lightning American, Lt. Surge. Boosts Speed and enables Fly.

name: Rainbow Badge
description: A colorful badge from Erika, the nature-loving princess of Celadon's Grass-type Gym.

name: Soul Badge
description: A heart-shaped badge from ninja master Koga, awarded for surviving his Poison-type tactics.

name: Marsh Badge
description: Won from Sabrina, the master of Psychic Pokémon and telekinetic powers.

name: Volcano Badge
description: The quiz-loving Fire master Blaine awards this badge to trainers who take the heat.

name: Earth Badge
description: The final Kanto badge, taken from Team Rocket's boss Giovanni himself.

name: Zephyr Badge
description: Johto's first badge, from Falkner, keeper of his father's Flying-type legacy.

name: Hive Badge
description: Awarded by Bugsy, the walking encyclopedia of Bug Pokémon and his fearsome Scyther.

name: Plain Badge
description: Won from Whitney — if you can topple her infamous Rollout Miltank.

name: Fog Badge
description: From Morty, the mystic of Ecruteak who trains to see the legendary Ho-Oh.

name: Storm Badge
description: Proof of beating Chuck, the Fighting-type master who trains under a waterfall.

name: Mineral Badge
description: From gentle Jasmine, the first Steel-type Gym Leader in Pokémon history.

name: Glacier Badge
description: The winter-hardened Pryce awards this for weathering his Ice-type onslaught.

name: Rising Badge
description: Clair's badge — she only hands it over after you pass the Dragon's Den trial too.

name: Stone Badge
description: Hoenn's first badge, from honor student Roxanne of the Rustboro Trainer's School.

name: Knuckle Badge
description: Won from Brawly, the big-wave surfer who trains Fighting Pokémon in dark caves.

name: Dynamo Badge
description: The jolly Wattson gives this up with a hearty laugh — and a shocking battle.

name: Heat Badge
description: From Flannery, the fiery rookie leader keeping her grandfather's gym blazing.

name: Balance Badge
description: Earned by defeating Norman — the player's own father in Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald.

name: Feather Badge
description: From Winona, the graceful sky tamer of the treetop city of Fortree.

name: Mind Badge
description: The twin leaders Tate & Liza award this after Hoenn's signature double battle.

name: Rain Badge
description: Hoenn's final badge, from the artist of water, Wallace — future regional Champion.

name: Coal Badge
description: Sinnoh's first badge, from mining prodigy Roark and his Cranidos.

name: Forest Badge
description: From Gardenia, the Grass-type master who is hilariously afraid of ghosts.

name: Cobble Badge
description: The barefoot fighter Maylene awards this for besting her disciplined team.

name: Fen Badge
description: From the masked wrestler Crasher Wake, guardian of the Great Marsh.

name: Relic Badge
description: The elegant contest star Fantina awards this for surviving her Ghost-type flair.

name: Mine Badge
description: From Byron, Roark's father, who guards Canalave with a wall of steel.

name: Icicle Badge
description: Won from the ever-cheerful Candice in the snowbound north of Sinnoh.

name: Beacon Badge
description: Sinnoh's final badge, from Volkner — the bored genius reignited by a good battle.

name: Trio Badge
description: Awarded by the triplet leaders — you face the one whose type counters your starter.

name: Basic Badge
description: From Lenora, the museum director whose Watchog and Herdier punish the unprepared.

name: Insect Badge
description: The artist Burgh awards this badge from his honeycomb-walled city gym.

name: Bolt Badge
description: From supermodel Elesa, whose Emolga duo has haunted many trainers.

name: Quake Badge
description: The mining magnate Clay hands this over only to trainers with real grit.

name: Jet Badge
description: From Skyla, the high-flying cargo pilot of Mistralton's runway gym.

name: Freeze Badge
description: The former movie star Brycen awards this for cracking his icy defenses.

name: Legend Badge
description: Unova's final badge, from the fearsome dragon sage Drayden.

name: Bug Badge
description: Kalos's first badge, from the battle-photographer Viola.

name: Cliff Badge
description: From Grant, the climbing champion whose gym is a sheer rock wall.

name: Rumble Badge
description: From roller-skating Korrina, keeper of the secrets of Mega Evolution.

name: Plant Badge
description: The old gardener Ramos awards this from his vine-covered treehouse gym.

name: Voltage Badge
description: From boy-genius inventor Clemont in the great tower of Lumiose City.

name: Fairy Badge
description: From Valerie, the fashion designer who battles with the newly discovered Fairy type.

name: Psychic Badge
description: The starry-cloaked seer Olympia awards this beneath her cosmic gym dome.

name: Iceberg Badge
description: Kalos's final badge, from Wulfric — a warm heart wrapped in ice.

name: Grass Badge
description: Galar's opening badge, from the easygoing farmer Milo and his Eldegoss.

name: Water Badge
description: From model-athlete Nessa, whose Drednaw crashes down in Gigantamax form.

name: Fire Badge
description: The veteran Kabu awards this after a disciplined trial by fire.

name: Fighting Badge
description: From karate prodigy Bea in Sword — Allister's Ghost badge takes its place in Shield.

name: Fairy Badge
description: The 88-year-old theater master Opal quizzes challengers before this badge is won.

name: Rock Badge
description: From Gordie in Sword — his mother Melony's Ice badge is earned in Shield.

name: Dark Badge
description: The punk-rock singer Piers battles old-school — no Dynamax, just attitude.

name: Dragon Badge
description: Galar's final badge, from Leon's greatest rival, the sandstorm tactician Raihan.

name: Cortondo Gym Badge
description: From pâtissière Katy, whose Bug-type team hides a sweet-toothed Teddiursa.

name: Artazon Gym Badge
description: The avant-garde artist Brassius awards this after his Sudowoodo masterpiece.

name: Levincia Gym Badge
description: From streamer sensation Iono — battles at her gym are broadcast live.

name: Cascarrafa Gym Badge
description: The master chef Kofu awards this badge with the same passion as his cooking.

name: Medali Gym Badge
description: From Larry, the deadpan salaryman who insists normal is best — he moonlights in the Elite Four.

name: Montenevera Gym Badge
description: MC Ryme raps her way through a Ghost-type double battle for this badge.

name: Alfornada Gym Badge
description: From influencer and makeup artist Tulip and her powerful Florges.

name: Glaseado Gym Badge
description: The retired pro snowboarder Grusha guards Paldea's coldest badge.
